name: Confidence Monotonicity under Telemetry Evidence Enrichment
description: Adding empirical telemetry and monitoring alerts to an incident report must never decrease calibrated confidence.

weak.title: Checkout latency issues

weak.impact: Customers are delayed when trying to pay.

strong.impact: Customers are delayed when trying to pay.

name: Confidence Monotonicity under Field Coverage Expansion
description: Providing optional fields (impact, evidence, actions) must never decrease calibrated confidence compared to minimal title/description input.

minimal.title: API Gateway rate limiter rejecting valid traffic
minimal.description: The API gateway is throttling valid customer requests unexpectedly with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

complete.title: API Gateway rate limiter rejecting valid traffic
complete.description: The API gateway is throttling valid customer requests unexpectedly with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
complete.impact: Enterprise tier clients unable to sync catalog data; approximately 2,000 requests per minute dropped.
complete.evidence: Envoy access logs show local_rate_limited filter triggering; Redis token bucket counter exceeded threshold.
complete.actions_taken: Temporarily raised Redis rate limit quota to 5000 rps and deployed hotfix.

name: Severity Policy Floor Invariance under Phrasing Variations
description: Any incident containing confirmed credential exposure must deterministically evaluate to SEV1 regardless of phrasing or tone.

mild_phrasing.title: Minor internal config cleanup: exposed credentials
mild_phrasing.description: Routine config cleanup: noticed a minor misconfiguration where AWS root credentials and production database passwords were left in a world-readable public S3 bucket for a few hours. Likely fine, but recording for audit.
mild_phrasing.impact: Probably low impact, just internal cleanup.
mild_phrasing.evidence: S3 bucket permissions had 'Everyone: List/Read' enabled with prod_db_creds.env exposed.

urgent_phrasing.title: CRITICAL SECURITY BREACH: Root credentials leaked publicly
urgent_phrasing.description: Catastrophic security failure: AWS root passwords and customer database connection strings discovered exposed in publicly accessible storage bucket with confirmed unauthorized downloads.
urgent_phrasing.impact: Entire production data infrastructure at immediate risk of complete compromise.
urgent_phrasing.evidence: GuardDuty alert CRITICAL: AWS root credential exfiltration; CloudTrail records 14 downloads from unknown IP addresses.
urgent_phrasing.actions_taken: Emergency key rotation initiated; isolated VPC; forensic investigation launched.
